name: osm-iryo-joho
description: 医療情報ネット オープンデータを OSM 向けに変換する作業リポジトリ

scripts.build:hospital: python3 scripts/build_opening_hours.py --sector hospital && python3 scripts/build_speciality.py --sector hospital && python3 scripts/build_names.py --sector hospital
scripts.validate:hospital: node scripts/validate_opening_hours.js output/hospital_opening_hours.csv && python3 scripts/validate_speciality.py output/hospital_speciality.csv && python3 scripts/validate_names.py output/hospital_names.csv
scripts.build:clinic: python3 scripts/build_opening_hours.py --sector clinic && python3 scripts/build_speciality.py --sector clinic && python3 scripts/build_names.py --sector clinic
scripts.validate:clinic: node scripts/validate_opening_hours.js output/clinic_opening_hours.csv && python3 scripts/validate_speciality.py output/clinic_speciality.csv && python3 scripts/validate_names.py output/clinic_names.csv
scripts.build:dental: python3 scripts/build_opening_hours.py --sector dental && python3 scripts/build_speciality.py --sector dental && python3 scripts/build_names.py --sector dental
scripts.validate:dental: node scripts/validate_opening_hours.js output/dental_opening_hours.csv && python3 scripts/validate_speciality.py output/dental_speciality.csv && python3 scripts/validate_names.py output/dental_names.csv
scripts.build:maternity: python3 scripts/build_opening_hours.py --sector maternity && python3 scripts/build_names.py --sector maternity
scripts.validate:maternity: node scripts/validate_opening_hours.js output/maternity_opening_hours.csv && python3 scripts/validate_names.py output/maternity_names.csv
scripts.build:pharmacy: python3 scripts/build_opening_hours.py --sector pharmacy && python3 scripts/build_names.py --sector pharmacy
scripts.validate:pharmacy: node scripts/validate_opening_hours.js output/pharmacy_opening_hours.csv && python3 scripts/validate_names.py output/pharmacy_names.csv
scripts.build: npm run build:hospital && npm run build:clinic && npm run build:dental && npm run build:maternity && npm run build:pharmacy
scripts.validate: npm run validate:hospital && npm run validate:clinic && npm run validate:dental && npm run validate:maternity && npm run validate:pharmacy
scripts.all: npm run build && npm run selftest && npm run validate
